reading_notes: The upper C24 terminal joins the source 00 line also read at V14 cathode and C17 negative; its lower terminal joins the left end of R49.
R49's right end reaches the A3 physical pin 5 noninverting input. The handwritten 'asymmetrie' annotation lies on this input branch and does not set a separate electrical value.
The four terminals are a local read. The continuation of 00 and other symmetry-control parts must be reviewed in the full page-10 netlist.
